_comment: GULA Cloudflare WAF rule-set — import via `wrangler` or the Cloudflare API. Rules run in order; first match wins. Designed for a national healthcare platform: conservative defaults, explicit allow-list for government webhook IPs, strict POST-body size cap, blanket block on common patient-data exfiltration patterns.

rules.description: Global sliding-window cap per IP across /api/*
Block classic SQL-injection signatures in query strings
rules.expression: (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union select" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "drop table" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "' or '1'='1")

rules.description: Cap request body at 10 MB — matches MAX_REQUEST_BODY_MB
API clients must declare a version header (defense in depth)
Allow-list inbound from declared Iraqi government webhook source IPs (placeholders — update before going live)
Any /webhooks/gov/* not from the allow-list is rejected
Admin endpoints are Iraq-only (+ listed partners)

notes: Rule ids are internal labels — Cloudflare assigns its own ids on import.
Before going LIVE, replace the 10.0.0.0/8 placeholder in allowlist-gov-webhook-ips with the actual MoH / MoI / NHI source ranges.
Rule rate-limit-auth uses Challenge, not Block, so a legitimate user locked out can solve a captcha within the cool-down.
